estimates.assumptions: Modest sprinkling of chilli flakes estimated at 2g (typical small pinch to light sprinkle amount; not a full teaspoon).
1 stock cube estimated at 6g total mass (standard cube weight); known calories used directly as they match typical per-cube values for dry bouillon.
Crusty bread 'to serve' estimated at 50g per serving (one modest slice or equivalent portion of a baguette-style loaf; typical calorie density for crusty white bread).
